narration: पारो को दोनों दीवारें एक साथ चाहिए। बीच में लैंप रखना है।
caption: Paro wants both walls at once. The lamp must stand in the middle.
image_brief: Paro on the floor between the two beds with her arms spread toward both bare walls, the lamp glowing near her feet.

narration: वह तार को दोनों हाथों से खींचती है।
caption: She pulls at the wire with both hands.
image_brief: Both of Paro's hands gripping the lamp's wire and hauling on it, her knuckles pale with the effort.

narration: तार में ढील नहीं बची। वह पूरा तन गया।
caption: No slack was left in the wire. It went completely tight.
image_brief: The wire lifted off the floorboards in one straight taut line running back to a low wall socket.

narration: लैंप तकिए के किनारे पर डोला, फिर फ़र्श पर गिर पड़ा।
caption: The lamp wobbled on the pillow's edge, then fell to the floor.
image_brief: The small lamp tipping off the edge of the pillow and dropping toward the wooden floor, light swinging wildly.

narration: काग़ज़ का शेड खिसककर उतर गया। बल्ब अब नंगा है।
caption: The paper shade slipped right off. The bulb is bare now.
image_brief: The loose paper shade lying on the floorboards beside a small bare bulb burning brightly on its stand.

narration: रोशनी अब हर तरफ़ फैल रही है। छत पर भी।
caption: The light spreads in every direction now. Onto the ceiling too.
image_brief: The ceiling and the tops of both walls flooded with harsh even light, the bare bulb small and glaring below.

narration: दोनों दीवारें दूध जैसी सफ़ेद पड़ गईं।
caption: Both walls turned milk white.
image_brief: Both bedroom walls washed flat and milky with light, not one shadow anywhere on them.

narration: कोई छाया नहीं बनी। न कान, न कोई किनारा।
caption: No shadow formed at all. No ears, no edge.
image_brief: Paro's hands shaping ears in front of the bare bulb while the wall behind them shows nothing at all.

narration: पहले एक खरगोश था। अब एक भी नहीं।
caption: Before there was one rabbit. Now there is not even one.
image_brief: Both girls' walls in a single frame, both of them blank and overbright, the beds untidy below.

narration: छोटी ने कंबल सिर तक खींच लिया। वह चुप हो गई।
caption: The little one pulled her blanket over her head. She went quiet.
image_brief: The younger sister on her bed with the thin blanket dragged up over her head, only her hair showing.

narration: कमरा सपाट और उजला है। कहीं कुछ नहीं हिलता।
caption: The room is flat and glaring. Nothing moves anywhere.
image_brief: The whole bedroom lit evenly and harshly from the floor, every corner pale, nothing in motion.

narration: पारो फ़र्श पर बैठी है, हाथ में काग़ज़ का शेड।
caption: Paro sits on the floor with the paper shade in her hand.
image_brief: Paro sitting cross-legged on the floorboards with the crumpled paper shade resting in her lap.

narration: सवाल बड़ा या साफ़ का नहीं रहा। अब कुछ भी नहीं है।
caption: It is no longer a question of big or sharp. Now there is nothing.
image_brief: The bent paper shade held between Paro's fingers, its creased edges catching the bulb's light.

narration: एक लैंप। दो दीवारें। और चारों तरफ़ बिखरी रोशनी।
caption: One lamp. Two walls. And light scattered all around.
image_brief: The bare bulb standing on the floorboards with its wire coiled beside it, light spraying out across the room.

narration: पारो ने काग़ज़ को उँगलियों में घुमाया और एक पतली नली बना दी।
caption: Paro rolled the paper in her fingers and made a narrow tube.
image_brief: Paro's fingers curling the paper shade around into a narrow tube, her thumbs holding the seam shut.
